title: welltest: one partly-valid distractor sharpened into a clearly wrong one

items.flag: distractor 2 (three points too few to fit reliably) close to partly valid
items.reason: 'too few points' echoes l05's point that real tests have too few stabilised points, so it could be half-defended; it now claims three points leave the back-pressure fit underdetermined, which l05 contradicts (two parameters, one degree of freedom left over, r squared near 1).

2.old: Because the three points are too few to determine two parameters plus an exponent reliably in either fit.
2.new: Because three points leave the back-pressure fit underdetermined, so its exponent is only loosely fixed by the data.
